spaces.label: Spaces
spaces.hint: A space that is only on this device is not synced: devices that still sync it lose it with their next sync. Profiles and favorites that only such spaces use stay here too.

code.label: Your sync code
code.hint: Enter these 24 words on another device to sync it. On a phone, “Scan QR Code” in Magnetite reads the QR code instead; a phone without that step takes the words. The words are the only key to your synced data, and the QR code holds them too: the server cannot read the data, and nobody can recover the words for you.
code.write_down: Write these words down or keep them in your password manager now.
code.qr_label: Your sync code as a QR code
code.qr_caption: For “Scan QR Code” in Magnetite on a phone

stop.label: Stop syncing
stop.hint: Leaving keeps the chain and your other devices as they are. Deleting removes the chain and all its data from the server for every device.
stop.delete_confirm: Click again to delete it from the server

server.label: Server
server.own_hint: Your own magnetite-sync server. github.com/magnetite-browser/magnetite-sync shows how to run one.
server.public_hint: Free to use, run by StackForge on servers in Germany. Starting a chain needs no account.

create.label: First device
create.hint: Magnetite creates a sync code for you to use on your other devices.
create.hint_only: Magnetite gives you 24 words, your sync code. Enter them on your other computers and they show the same sidebar.
create.invite: Invite code, if the server needs one

join.label: Another device
join.hint: Enter the 24 words from Settings → Sync on a device that already syncs.
join.hint_only: The 24 words that Settings → Sync shows on a device that already syncs.

zero_knowledge: Zero knowledge: the server only ever sees an anonymous key and encrypted data padded to fixed sizes. No email, no password, no device names, no content.
kept_own: How long an unused chain is kept is up to the server's operator.
kept_public: Chains nobody uses for 400 days are deleted.
